scenes.title: Welcome
scenes.narration: Welcome to the Lobo Infinity Portal. This walkthrough shows you how to find a game, prepare for it, submit your result, and explore the community.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Dashboard
scenes.narration: On the dashboard, Choose Your First Move takes you to Army Intelligence, a battle report, or events. Public browsing is open to everyone. Use Explore to find the portal’s other tools and directories.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Navigation and page controls
scenes.narration: The links above the page show where you are and let you return to a parent section. On pages with an artwork control, choose Show full artwork or Use compact artwork; your preference carries across supported pages. Check Data last updated when interpreting results. If a page reports a loading error, use its Retry button.
scenes.visual: Show breadcrumbs and the artwork toggle on Army Lists, then show the data cutoff in the footer. Show Retry only if a real error state is available.

scenes.title: Events
scenes.narration: Select All Events in the sidebar. Open the event you want to join and check its registration status. For casual games, use the Game Network or find players on Discord.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Standings
scenes.narration: Use the event selector in the sidebar to choose your competition. The links below it lead to that event. In Standings, choose your division to see the players and recorded scores.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Mission & Map
scenes.narration: Before arranging a league game, open Mission and Map. Check the date range, the active missions, and the assigned maps. View Mission opens the scenario details from Mission Geist.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: TTS Map Library
scenes.narration: Open the T T S Map Library to preview tables. Scroll down to search by map name, filter by named mission setup, or sort by highest rated. Check the collection for your event.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Table details
scenes.narration: Open a table card to inspect its terrain. The overhead view shows the layout, and the angled view shows heights and cover. Use the Workshop collection link, then match the bag name shown here.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Submit Game
scenes.narration: After playing, select Submit Game. Choose the form that matches your game: League, Team Tournament, Casual, or Top Forty. Each button opens its own Google Form. Check your scores with your opponent before submitting.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Battle Reports
scenes.narration: Open Battle Reports to browse recorded games. Each row shows the players, mission, and scores. Click the game number to open the full report.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Report details
scenes.narration: The report shows the objective points, tournament points, and victory points. Scroll for the mission summary, map, highlights, and review. Battle stories are fictionalized; use the recorded results and player notes for the factual account.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Army Intelligence
scenes.narration: Open Army Intelligence. Choose a faction or sectorial, or try the Corregidor example. This page explores submitted lists, common profiles, specialist coverage, and battlefield roles.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Known Army Lists
scenes.narration: In Army Intelligence, select Known Army Lists to open the Army Lists page. The faction filter is already set to the faction or sectorial you were viewing. From here, search the submitted lists or narrow them by mission. Clear filters when you want to browse other armies.
scenes.visual: Show Known Army Lists summary card, then the verified filtered Army Lists page.

scenes.title: Army Lists on desktop
scenes.narration: On a desktop, choose View List to open the roster in Corvus Belli Infinity Army. You can also open Army Lists directly from the sidebar. Use its search, faction, and mission filters to find a list, and select a column heading to sort the table.
scenes.visual: Highlight View List and the search, faction and mission filters on the current desktop page.

scenes.title: Army Lists on mobile
scenes.narration: On a phone, the action is Copy Army Code. Tap it to copy the list’s code, then paste that code into Infinity Army’s import tool. Army Intelligence’s Known Army Lists link still takes you to the same faction-filtered Army Lists page.
scenes.visual: Capture actual responsive mobile Army Lists layout and demonstrate Copy Army Code with its copied confirmation. Do not substitute a cropped desktop screenshot.

scenes.title: Rankings
scenes.narration: Use Combat, Defense, Control, or All to browse tactical roles. Global benchmark rank compares a profile across all armies. In-faction benchmark rank compares it within the army you selected. Check the exact weapon and combat state, such as non-linked or Fireteam plus one special die. The benchmark rating, letter grade, and global percentile describe combat performance. Submitted-list popularity tells you how often players used that profile. Compare matching combat states, and read each rank’s total number of profiles.
scenes.visual: Show current ranking cards; highlight global rank, in-faction rank, weapon, combat state, rating, grade, percentile and submitted-list popularity in that order.

scenes.title: Factions
scenes.narration: Open Factions to explore armies and sectorials through games recorded on the portal. Open an army’s card for its results and recent reports. Read the game count alongside the record and win rate. These numbers describe submitted games, rather than every game played by that faction.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Players
scenes.narration: Open Players to browse the community. Use the event filter for All Events or a specific competition. Each card shows a player’s division, game count, and record. Open a card to view their profile, then scroll to Game History to explore their recorded games.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Missions
scenes.narration: Open Missions and choose an event, or leave All Events selected. View Mission opens the available scenario details. Click a mission name for its analysis, including recorded games, first-turn win rate, faction performance, and recent battle reports. Read the number of games alongside each percentage.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Lobo’s Little Helper
scenes.narration: Open Lobo’s Little Helper for the updated guide and Discord link. In Discord, start with slash help. Use slash list analyse with an Army code for a readable roster, legality summary, and two D Tabletop Simulator export. Tactical Brief, Ratings, Classifieds, and T T S Notes open privately through buttons. Use slash combat matchup to compare two profiles, slash combat counters for reactive answers, and slash play for availability and game requests.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.

scenes.title: Your next move
scenes.narration: You are ready to use the portal. Find an event or an opponent, check your mission and map, play your game, and submit the result. Return for reports, rankings, and inspiration for your next list.
scenes.visual: Capture the current page and action described in the narration.
